initial_provider_text: {"game":"Super Mario Bros 1-1","instructions":"You control Mario in Super Mario Bros. World1-1. Reach the flag alive. Holding A throughout ascent makes a higher, longer jump. Releasing A early during ascent makes a low, short hop. Pressing A while airborne does not start another jump on later landing. Release A during descent so it is ready for the next grounded takeoff. Holding A through landing does not automatically jump again. Enemy side contact kills small Mario; descending onto enemies stomps them. Jump early enough to rise before enemy side contact. Gaps require takeoff near the visible edge so the jump lasts until the far side. Pipes and stairs support Mario: feet must rise above their top before the body crosses the side. A ceiling stops ascent. Momentum persists when controls are released. Avoid unnecessary hopping on open flat ground; it can waste the next jump near a hazard. Background hills are decorative. Game pauses while deciding. All choices are yours. CURRENT full screenshot is FIRST. Any PAST screenshot is labelled and appears last. Mario is the red/brown person; brown mushroom-shaped enemies are different characters. A near landing is still airborne: feet must actually touch a solid surface before a NEW jump can begin. Infer contact and ascent/descent from the pixels, including the labelled past image.
